relationship: Fixed-width registers connect number representations, arithmetic and bit operations to the values they encode, the results they produce and the information lost through overflow or shifts.

learnerLoop.action: Choose a curriculum and question range, reason from the register, and enter or select an answer.
learnerLoop.modelChange: The generated task applies a representation or operation permitted by the selected curriculum; the learner’s answer is checked against that task.
learnerLoop.evidence: Register bits, place values, operation displays, answer feedback and worked explanations connect the result to its representation and bit width.
learnerLoop.nextDecision: Use the evidence to correct the reasoning, compare representations or operations, or practise another task within the selected curriculum.

invariants: Bit patterns, numeric interpretations and worked answers agree with the stated representation and register width.
Unsigned overflow, signed overflow and bits lost or recirculated in a shift remain distinguishable.
Generated tasks belong to the selected curriculum; showing hints or changing the question range does not introduce AS-only content into IGCSE.
safeAdaptations: Vary values, contexts, visual representations and working support while preserving the mathematical meaning of the register and operations.
Reorganise practice or add explanations within the documented curriculum features; extend curricular content only when explicitly requested.
nonGoals: Floating-point representation and processor execution are outside this integer-register practice lab.
A harder question does not by itself justify introducing a feature from another curriculum.

integer-conversions.description: Convert between positive denary and fixed-width binary integers.

unsigned-arithmetic.description: Add positive binary integers and identify fixed-width overflow.

logical-shifts.description: Apply logical shifts and relate discarded bits to the resulting unsigned value.

twos-complement.description: Represent and negate signed integers using two’s complement.

ones-complement.description: Convert signed integers between denary, one’s complement and two’s complement.

bcd-conversions.description: Encode and decode individual decimal digits using Binary Coded Decimal.

storage-prefixes.description: Distinguish decimal and binary magnitude prefixes when converting storage quantities.

signed-arithmetic.description: Add and subtract signed binary integers and detect signed overflow.

arithmetic-shifts.description: Apply arithmetic shifts to signed registers, preserving or interpreting the sign.

cyclic-shifts.description: Rotate bits through a fixed-width register.

bitwise-operations.description: Apply AND, OR and XOR masks and use masks to set or test a selected bit.

hexadecimal-conversions.description: Convert integers between denary, binary and hexadecimal.
